question: Where can I find the closest nature reserve near Malibu Jack's, Springfield, IL?
sql: WITH reference_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Malibu Jack\'s%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Springfield%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT CASE WHEN p.poi_name IS NOT NULL THEN p.poi_name WHEN k.park_name IS NOT NULL THEN k.park_name END AS nature_reserve_name FROM ( SELECT id, geometry, poi_name, NULL::text AS park_name, geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM reference_location) AS distance_order FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve' UNION ALL SELECT id, geometry, NULL::text AS poi_name, park_name, geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM reference_location) AS distance_order FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve' ) AS combined_results ORDER BY distance_order ASC LIMIT 1;
